title: 第13章 最好的朋友（下）
slug: 从素晴开始成为海贼王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

当林北三人跑出海军基地时，身后的追兵居然意料之外地没有继续追赶。

并非他们不想，而是除了被悠悠击倒的那些士兵，还有大批伤员正从酒馆方向被陆续抬了回来。

如果继续战斗下去，整个支部的海军说不定真的会全军覆没。

堂堂一个海军基地，居然差点被几个半大孩子给端了。

这种事要是传出去，海军的脸都要丢尽了。

奇耻大辱，简直是奇耻大辱。

码头港口。

林北一边起锚一边质问。

“你们两个，到底为什么要袭击那个叫蒙卡的海军？”

悠悠低着头，一言不发。

林北瞥了惠惠一眼。

“她怎么了？这次居然不是你惹出来的麻烦？”

惠惠顿时炸毛：“什么叫居然不是我惹出来的麻烦？我是那种会经常惹麻烦的人吗？”

“是啊。”

“咕……”

就在这时，悠悠终于开口。

“林北先生……这件事不怪惠惠，都是我的错。是我……是我没忍住……对不起……林北先生……我、我不配做你的朋友……”

话没说完，她的眼泪便止不住地往下淌，哭得上气不接下气。

这回轮到林北慌了。

“怎么了？有事好好说，你别哭啊。”

他蹲下身，手忙脚乱地帮她擦眼泪。

“到底怎么回事？谁欺负你了？你告诉我，老子去砍了他！”

一旁忍了半天的惠惠终于忍不住叫出声来。

“你这家伙，对待我们两个的差别也太明显了吧！”

“至少某人没有连续两天朝海面放爆裂魔法，也没有连续两次差点害我们船毁人亡。”

惠惠立刻闭嘴了。

昨天她确实没忍住。

为了在路飞面前显摆一手，她偷偷背着林北又往海面上轰了一发爆裂魔法。

结果确实被路飞夸了两句，但事后也被林北骂了半天。

林北没再理她，走到悠悠身边，揉了揉她的脑袋。

“前天你不还说，我们是最好的朋友吗？既然是最好的朋友，不管发生什么事，我都会站在你这边的。”

悠悠听完，愣了一瞬，然后哭得更大声了。

惠惠看不下去了。

“还是我来说吧。”

她深吸一口气，把前因后果和盘托出。

“都怪那个叫蒙卡的家伙。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When Lin Bei and the other three ran out of the naval base, the pursuers behind them unexpectedly did not continue to pursue them.

It's not that they don't want to, but in addition to the soldiers who were knocked down by Youyou, there are also a large number of wounded people who are being carried back from the direction of the tavern.

If the fighting continues, the entire branch's navy may really be wiped out.

It was a naval base, but it was almost carried by a few half-year-old children.

If this kind of thing spreads, the Navy will be completely embarrassed.

What a shame, what a shame.

Marina port.

Lin Bei asked as he lifted anchor.

"Why on earth did you two attack that navy named Mengka?"

Youyou lowered her head and said nothing.

Lin Bei glanced at Huihui.

"What's wrong with her? It's not you who caused the trouble this time?"

Huihui suddenly became furious: "What do you mean it's not me who caused the trouble? Am I the kind of person who often causes trouble?"

"Yeah."

"Gu..."

At this moment, Youyou finally spoke.

"Mr. Lin Bei... It's not Huihui's fault for this, it's all my fault. It's me... I couldn't hold it back... I'm sorry... Mr. Lin Bei... I, I don't deserve to be your friend..."

Before she finished speaking, her tears couldn't stop flowing down, and she was out of breath from crying.

This time it was Lin Bei's turn to panic.

"What's wrong? Tell me if you have something to say. Don't cry."

He knelt down and hurriedly wiped her tears.

"What's going on? Who bullied you? Tell me, I'm going to kill him!"

Huihui, who had endured it for a long time, finally couldn't help but scream.

"You guys, the difference in how you treat us is too obvious!"

"At least someone didn't cast explosive magic on the sea for two days in a row, and he didn't almost destroy our ship twice in a row."

Megumin immediately shut up.

She really couldn't hold it back yesterday.

In order to show off her skills in front of Luffy, she secretly carried Lin Bei and blasted another explosion magic on the sea.

In the end, Luffy did praise him a few words, but he was also scolded by Lin Bei for a long time afterwards.

Lin Bei ignored her, walked to Youyou and rubbed her head.

"Didn't you say the day before yesterday that we are best friends? Since we are best friends, no matter what happens, I will stand by your side."

After hearing this, Yuyou was stunned for a moment, and then cried even louder.

Megumin couldn't stand it anymore.

"Let me tell you."

She took a deep breath and told the whole story.

"It's all the fault of that guy named Mengka."
